Company Description
To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

Job Description
CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Environment Concept Artist to join our studio in Boston and help us develop Cyberpunk 2 - the follow-up to Cyberpunk 2077 and the next major video game in the Cyberpunk franchise. As a Senior Environment Concept Artist, you’ll be a part of a team of talented artists, working in close collaboration with Art Directors to help establish the vision and visual direction for the game. If you are an experienced artist with a passion for world building and creating industry-leading RPGs, we want to hear from you!
Responsibilities:

• Create high quality, creative and original environment concept art.
• Work closely with directors to establish a clear vision and direction for the game.
• Collaborate and work as part of a team of artists, sharing information, ideas and knowledge to benefit the project as a whole.
• Participate in peer group feedback sessions regularly, attending reviews, receiving feedback and making iterations.
• Collaborate closely with other departments and teams to get the information and support needed to achieve goals and solve problems.
• Maintain the production pipeline and meet deadlines.

Qualifications
• A minimum of 5 years experience as a Concept Artist in game development.
• In-depth knowledge of the Cyberpunk genre and RPGs with a passion for environment design.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to share creative ideas and concepts clearly and effectively.
• Exceptional creative and artistic skills, with a portfolio demonstrating expertise in realistic and sci-fi environment concept art, mood paintings, 3D environment designs, blockouts and paintovers, key-frames, and the ability to create fast ideation sketches such as storyboards.
• A solid background in traditional art such as industrial design, landscape painting or illustration with core foundational skills.
• Excellent knowledge of both 2d and 3d design software.
• Openness for constant feedback and sharing knowledge with other concept artists.
• Ability to work collaboratively with other teams online in different time zones.

Additional Information
The application window for this position will close by 11/15/2026

This job requires working in Boston, US.

Working mode: in-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity.

As part of our pre-employment process, candidates selected for this position will be required to complete a background check in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
Health & Well-Being

• Company-paid medical healthcare (dental, vision, and mental).
• Free mental health support, including access to counseling, psychiatric care, and a variety of well-being webinars.
• Paid leave — 26 days of vacation, 10 sick days, & 12 calendar holidays per year
• 401K with employer matching.
• Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) – $100 per month to use towards fitness, wellness, internet, home office equipment, learning, streaming services, and more.
• Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
• RED Parents Network — support for working parents.
• Flexible working hours.
Perks & Professional Growth

• Trainings, lectures, and courses — internal workshops, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available.
• A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
Life in the Office

• Dog-friendly office — bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet.
• Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
• No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.
This position is a replacement.
Estimated pay range for this position: $99,000 - $163,000 USD annually
